nomineeA.longerDescription:
Happy ww! This week I am nominating mratedMorgan! Lately I have been consuming a lot of motorcycle content and then she randomly popped up on my feed with the following video:
https://www.facebook.com/reel/38567055666226733
I was immediately struck by her looks but I think I watched it early in the morning and it was so confusing to me what the other porsche guy did so I had to watch it like 5x at least. After this one tho I followed her though and realized she has a crazy collection, including bikes. She has a gt4 rs + i4 m50 🏍️ s1k (x2) + zx6r. I mean pretty generic, but cool cars and bikes nonetheless. Also she is quite blessed in both departments so she is quite dreamy. Face card is not my favorite, but the rest of what I know about her makes up for it. One more reason to like Porsches, if I saw her in hers I would be waving extra hard.

nomineeA.shortDescription: Emmy-winning actress, singer, and fashion icon
nomineeA.longerDescription: Zendaya has established herself as one of the most talented young actresses of her generation. From her Disney Channel beginnings to her powerful performances in Euphoria and the Dune franchise, she brings depth and authenticity to every role. She's also a fashion icon known for her bold red carpet choices and her work as a producer.

nomineeB.shortDescription: British actress known for powerful performances
nomineeB.longerDescription: Florence Pugh has rapidly become one of the most respected actresses in cinema. Known for her roles in Midsommar, Little Women, and Black Widow, she brings incredible emotional depth and fearlessness to her performances. Her versatility spans from period dramas to psychological horror to superhero blockbusters.

nomineeA.shortDescription: Cuban-Spanish actress and rising Hollywood star
nomineeA.longerDescription: Ana de Armas has captivated audiences with her performances in films like Knives Out, No Time to Die, and Blonde. Originally from Cuba, she has successfully transitioned to Hollywood stardom while maintaining her distinctive charm and talent. Her portrayal of Marilyn Monroe in Blonde earned widespread critical acclaim.

nomineeB.longerDescription: Emma Stone is one of the most acclaimed actresses of her generation. From her breakout in Easy A to her Oscar-winning performance in La La Land, she consistently delivers performances that are both emotionally resonant and technically brilliant. Her recent work in Poor Things has earned widespread praise.

nomineeA.longerDescription: Anya Taylor-Joy has become one of the most distinctive talents in cinema. Her haunting performance in The Witch launched her career, and she's since starred in Split, Emma, The Queen's Gambit, and Furiosa. Her ethereal beauty and intense performances make every role memorable.

nomineeB.shortDescription: Actress known for Euphoria and The White Lotus
nomineeB.longerDescription: Sydney Sweeney has quickly become one of Hollywood's most talked-about young actresses. Her performances in Euphoria and The White Lotus showcase her incredible range and emotional depth. She's also ventured into producing and has become a cultural phenomenon with her authentic social media presence.

nomineeA.shortDescription: Israeli actress and former model, Wonder Woman star
nomineeA.longerDescription: Gal Gadot became a global icon as Wonder Woman, bringing strength, grace, and humanity to the superhero role. A former Miss Israel and IDF veteran, she has starred in the Fast & Furious franchise and numerous blockbusters. Her charisma and presence have made her one of the most recognizable actresses worldwide.

nomineeB.shortDescription: Rising star actress, known for Wednesday
nomineeB.longerDescription: Jenna Ortega has emerged as one of Gen Z's most exciting talents. Her portrayal of Wednesday Addams became a cultural phenomenon, showcasing her ability to bring depth and nuance to iconic characters. She's also starred in Scream and X, proving her versatility across genres.

nomineeA.longerDescription: Blake Lively rose to fame in Gossip Girl and has maintained a successful film career with roles in The Age of Adaline, A Simple Favor, and The Shallows. Beyond acting, she's a successful entrepreneur and is known for her impeccable fashion sense at major events. She brings charm, wit, and intelligence to everything she does.

nomineeB.longerDescription: Lily Collins has charmed audiences with her performances in Emily in Paris, Mirror Mirror, and Love, Rosie. The daughter of musician Phil Collins, she's carved out her own successful career with grace and talent. Her natural elegance and strong performances have made her a beloved figure in entertainment.

nomineeA.longerDescription: Hailee Steinfeld earned an Oscar nomination at age 14 for True Grit and has since built an impressive career as both an actress and singer. From her role in the Pitch Perfect franchise to Hawkeye in the MCU, and hits like 'Starving' and 'Let Me Go,' she excels in every medium she explores.

nomineeB.longerDescription: Saoirse Ronan is one of the most acclaimed actresses of her generation. With multiple Oscar nominations for films like Lady Bird, Little Women, Brooklyn, and Atonement, she consistently delivers performances of extraordinary depth and nuance. Her ability to embody complex characters has made her a critical darling.

nomineeA.shortDescription: Pop superstar, actress, and vocal powerhouse
nomineeA.longerDescription: Ariana Grande is one of the biggest pop stars in the world, known for her incredible four-octave vocal range and hit songs like 'Thank U, Next' and '7 Rings.' Beyond music, she's acted in Victorious, appeared in films, and used her platform for social causes. Her talent, style, and authenticity have earned her millions of devoted fans.

nomineeB.shortDescription: Global music icon and songwriter extraordinaire
nomineeB.longerDescription: Taylor Swift is one of the best-selling music artists of all time. From her country roots to pop dominance to indie-folk exploration, she's constantly evolved while maintaining her signature storytelling prowess. The Eras Tour became the highest-grossing tour ever, cementing her status as a cultural phenomenon. Her songwriting has earned countless awards and influenced a generation.
